portal_hypertension.title: An 8-year-old boy with recurrent jaundice.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：一名8岁男孩自婴儿期起就出现反复黄疸。 临床提示：他生长发育正常，没有慢性肝病的临床特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: An 8-year-old boy presented with recurrent jaundice since early infancy. He had normal growth and development and no clinical features of chronic liver disease. Investigations repeatedly demonstrated predominantly conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia, with normal liver enzymes and preserved synthetic function. Haemolytic evaluation was negative, and abdominal ultrasonography showed mild hepatomegaly with normal echotexture, without biliary dilatation, gallstones, chronic liver disease, or portal hypertension. portal_hypertension.title: Laparoscopic liver resection versus radiofrequency ablation for solitary small hepatocellular carcinoma in elderly patients: A multicenter propensity score-matched study.
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Multicenter Study / Comparative Study
portal_hypertension.authors: Yang S, Feng J, Zou M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究。核心观点：老年孤立性小肝细胞癌的最佳局部治疗仍不清楚。 临床提示：这项多中心倾向评分匹配研究比较了该人群中腹腔镜肝切除术和射频消融术的围手术期和长期结果。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The optimal local treatment for solitary small hepatocellular carcinoma in elderly patients remains unclear. This multicenter propensity score-matched study compared perioperative and long-term outcomes between laparoscopic liver resection and radiofrequency ablation in this population. Elderly patients (defined as age ≥70 years) with solitary hepatocellular carcinoma ≤3 cm who underwent laparoscopic liver resection or radiofrequency ablation at 8 tertiary centers were included.
